summary: The agent performs extensive and generally well-structured feature engineering and correctly sets up a validation split initially. However, it critically fails at the final evaluation stage by retraining its model on the combined train and validation sets and then evaluating it on the validation set, causing severe data leakage. Additionally, unsafe string operations in the feature engineering pipeline likely lead to an execution crash.
